chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu abakuk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duuñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jiiñak tu' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook cham u'ua'tɨda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' dhaibu jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' jix bhai'x jir bhai' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' cham.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Kaldeos gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam sɨsɨɨ' gu xumai; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr aajim kavaayo gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu jɨvɨl; mi' dhɨr na ja'p oo'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'; gio ba' bɨx gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook oo' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' dhi' bɨxchu'x gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan cham koi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Roka na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui na ba' cham bhai' tu' no'p; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix bhai'x jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' duñia' ka't gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' na ja'p gu ko'oi cham namki' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bɨɨx jix vɨgɨ; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' makgɨrxi'ñdha' jix vɨgɨ; na gu' bɨɨx jix bhai'x jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix vɨgɨ jix duñia' kooda' chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' bhaan jix nukadham dhi' bhaan gu kavɨk gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook no'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ua'ñxidha' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook cham gu masad; gio ba' cham jix duñia' ɨlhdham; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia'.
Gu' na jaroi' jir bɨx bhai' bhaan gu Jawatan, mi' dhɨr na jix bhaan jum ai'ch oidha'.
Na gu' gio na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu chio'ñ cham; na jix duñia' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p koi'm cham; mi' dhɨr va'k jum daa'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' ja'tkam bhaan ua'rgidhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix mui' cham ka't bɨɨx ka'm duuk ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' cham jix búup jix bhai'x tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' pai' ka'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kuiñcha gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' jɨ'dɨlh bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak jix dhaas jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak mui'x gu ja'tkam uañi'ñ bhaan gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' gu jodai tu ñi'ook dɨr vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tai chɨbɨɨp jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup machia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa i'i gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhat; gio ba' i'i tu' gio ka' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Liibano bhaan tu' chajaañ jix duñia'; gio ba' kuiñcha gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' jɨ'dɨlh bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook na ba' duñia' jix bhai'x tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai; jano' ba' bamii' gu Podraa gu ñi'ook gu Miren jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai jix toja jodai cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' soi'm gu abakuk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bhaan gu Sigionot.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim jix maati'; mi' dhɨr daak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham gu Temaan jix bhaan gu kavɨk gu Paraan; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' jix bhaan dhaas gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' jix bhuup bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p gu tasi'; gio ba' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr ka't gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' jix duu chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu kakkavɨk jix bɨɨx duu; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' buupui vaak zel gu Kusaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' vaak zel gu oidha' gu Madiaan gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't daak bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' na pai' dhuuk bhaan jix duñia' bhaan tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Sela; mi' dhɨr gu endiste gu oidha' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chooto'n choo'n gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaam suudai' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tas gu masad gu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' gu tasi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx daak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨɨx i'iich chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaan mo'o gu vaak jix bhai'x jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm baakux; mi' dhɨr gu Sela; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ɨɨbhidham na ja'p na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' ka't na ja'p na ba' gampai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' kavaayo gɨ' kavɨk gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook vook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui o'oo gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk tu' xoi'kam dhi' gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam iigɨx cham tu' gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jugi kakneer ka't cham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' bhaan.
